title: What happened in AI — Oct 23, 2026
intro: Agent security dominated the day: OpenAI detailed tighter containment for frontier training, and Axios reported unvetted AI agents already accessing U.S. bank accounts.
On the infrastructure side, vLLM shipped long-context GLM-5.3 serving and day-0 MiniMax-M3.1-Flash support, and Chinese open-weight models kept widening their reach.
highlights: OpenAI hardens frontier training and evaluation environments with offline setups and high-compute red-teaming.
Axios: unvetted AI agents are accessing U.S. bank accounts.
Anthropic launches opt-in OSS Scanner for open-source maintainers.
vLLM serves GLM-5.3 at 1M-token context on 16 H200s, 1.7–3.2× faster per user.
Kimi K3.1 Pro lands on the API; weights promised by Nov 4.
DeepSeek and MiniMax win approval for global use, per Reuters.

categories.name: Agent Context and Harness Design
categories.summary: Two builds show where agent harnesses are heading: smarter retrieval into context, and a harness that extends itself.

articles.title: Context Engineering (Agent Memory) for AI Agents Starts with Retrieval
articles.summary: LangChain's Deep Agents harness uses targeted retrieval to cut clumsy searches, oversized results and stale data from agent context.

articles.title: Ultimate: A self-extending agent harness built on Pi Durable
articles.summary: A write-up of a self-extending agent harness built on Pi Durable, a durable-execution base for long-running agents.

articles.title: Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning on Amazon SageMaker AI: A hands-on guide
articles.summary: AWS walks the full multi-turn RL pipeline on SageMaker AI, training on whole-task outcomes instead of labeled steps, using Wordle as the example.

categories.name: Agent Security and Containment
categories.summary: Labs and researchers are tightening containment around agents, while unvetted agents reportedly already reach bank accounts.

articles.title: Securing our frontier model training environment
articles.summary: OpenAI details stronger containment for frontier model training and evaluation, including offline environments and high-compute red-teaming.

articles.title: Red-Teaming OpenAI's Internal Agent Monitoring Systems
articles.summary: Redwood Research red-teams OpenAI's internal agent monitoring systems.

articles.title: Scoop: Unvetted AI agents are accessing U.S. bank accounts
articles.summary: Axios reports unvetted AI agents are accessing U.S. bank accounts, raising agent identity and authorization questions.

articles.title: Anthropic Adds Opt-In Security Scanning for Critical Open-Source Projects
articles.summary: Anthropic's free, opt-in OSS Scanner sends enrolled maintainers periodic vulnerability reports generated by its strongest models.

articles.title: AI Coding Agent Security Benchmark
articles.summary: Endor Labs publishes a security benchmark for AI coding agents.

categories.name: Inference and Infrastructure
categories.summary: Serving stacks and storage are being tuned for long-context, agentic load, and Trainium now targets training as well as inference.

articles.title: GLM-5.3 Optimizations, Part 2: PCP, DCP, and Hybrid HiSparse on 16 H200s
articles.summary: vLLM serves GLM-5.3 on 16 H200s, reaching 1M-token contexts at 1.7–3.2× the per-user speed of data-parallel P/D on the AgentX agentic benchmark.

articles.title: vLLM Delivers Day-0 Support for MiniMax-M3.1-Flash
articles.summary: vLLM ships day-0 MiniMax-M3.1-Flash support on NVIDIA Blackwell, NVIDIA Rubin and AMD MI350-series GPUs, with NVFP4 kernels and speculative decoding.

articles.title: Amazon’s Trainium Takes a Strike at the Training King
articles.summary: SemiAnalysis argues Amazon's Trainium is now viable for training, citing native PyTorch support, TorchTitan and CI quality.

articles.title: Rapidly scaling online storage to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users (Part II)
articles.summary: OpenAI describes scaling Habitat storage on Azure Cosmos DB with multi-tenancy and global caching, for 12× faster reads in ChatGPT.

articles.title: China's DeepSeek, MiniMax win approval for AI global use, state media-affiliated entity says
articles.summary: Chinese state-media-affiliated body approves DeepSeek and MiniMax for global use, per Reuters.
